The cue outlasts the motion it caused. CHORUS remains where the cue brought it, and SOLOIST's hand remains raised; neither state decays when the initiating movement ends. GATE stays shut while the raised hand and advanced rows remain the established answer. The audience reads the changed formation as the reply rather than as passing background motion, and the exchange lands near a boundary without claiming to open it. The film ends on that stable relation.
